announcements.title: Android app 1.1.0: please install this update
announcements.body: This release needs a one-time install. Tap "Update available" at the top of Home, or download it below. Your bookmarks and settings are kept, and future updates arrive automatically again.

announcements.title: A fuller Panchangam, for any city and any day
announcements.body: Choose any city in the world and pick any date. The Tithi and Nakshatram rows now show when each one changes during the day, and the observances published by Srimad Andavan Ashramam appear on their dates.

announcements.title: Blogs are now in the Library
announcements.body: Āzhwār Vaibhavam, Nityasūri Vaibhavam and Temples and Festivals can now be read in the Library, with photos, cover artwork and translations.

announcements.title: The daily Sankalpam, in your language
announcements.body: The Sankalpam is now written in the language and script you read the app in: Tamil, Kannada, Hindi, Telugu or English.

announcements.title: Telugu in the Android app
announcements.body: Version 1.0.3 of the Android app adds Telugu, including Telugu Pasurams for all 108 Divya Desams. From this version on, new content and fixes arrive automatically without reinstalling.
